verdict: Spend is up sharply; leads are flat — we're fixing the gap now.
narrative: Over the last 28 days you received 10 tracked leads at a cost of $254.03 per lead, while total ad spend reached $2,540.32 — with Google ads alone accounting for nearly $2,000 of that. Google spend jumped 54% week-over-week, but tracked leads did not move, which points to a conversion tracking issue on the Google side that is being investigated and repaired now. Separately, the lead intake workflow needs an updated owner confirmed on your end, as automations built to respond to new leads quickly appear to be pointing at a vacant role. Once tracking is restored and intake is reassigned, the spend already in market should start producing visible results.

highlights.phrase: leads tracked over the last 28 days
cost per lead this period, up 41% from the prior week as spend rose faster than results
Google Business Profile actions (calls, directions, website clicks) generated organically this period

watch_item.issue: Google Ads is spending at an increased rate but not recording leads — conversion tracking appears broken on the website side, causing real results to go uncounted.
watch_item.fix: Conversion tracking is being audited and repaired this week so that spend and lead counts can be reconciled accurately.
